title: 分级 · 小学｜生活与课堂 · 60 句
description: 从课堂参与、整理书包、家庭分工到餐桌表达与同伴交往。适合小学中高年级的基础句子练习。

items.en: May I sit here?
answers: May I sit here?

items.en: I have not finished writing my name.
answers: I have not finished writing my name.
I haven't finished writing my name.

items.en: Open your book to page eight, please.
answers: Open your book to page eight, please.

items.en: Who wants to try first?
answers: Who wants to try first?

items.en: This question has two answers.
answers: This question has two answers.

items.en: The words on the board are too small.
answers: The words on the board are too small.

items.zh: 我们可以两个人一起做。
items.en: We can work in pairs.
answers: We can work in pairs.

items.en: There goes the bell. Pack your things away.
answers: There goes the bell. Pack your things away.
items.notes: There goes the bell：铃响了；pack away：收好。

items.en: I know how to spell this word.
answers: I know how to spell this word.

items.zh: 请在正确的图片下面画线。
items.en: Draw a line under the correct picture.
answers: Draw a line under the correct picture.

items.zh: 我的橡皮掉到桌子下面了。
items.en: My rubber fell under the desk.
answers: My rubber fell under the desk.
items.notes: fell 是 fall 的过去式；under：在下面。

items.en: This cup is not mine.
answers: This cup is not mine.
This cup isn't mine.
items.notes: mine：我的东西，后面不再接名词。

items.zh: 你的名字在书的封面上。
items.en: Your name is on the book cover.
answers: Your name is on the book cover.

items.zh: 我把午餐盒放进书包了。
items.en: I put my lunch box in my schoolbag.
answers: I put my lunch box in my schoolbag.

items.en: This schoolbag opens from the side.
answers: This schoolbag opens from the side.
items.notes: from the side：从侧面；opens 表示打开方式。

items.en: Bring only the books you need tomorrow.
answers: Bring only the books you need tomorrow.
items.notes: only：只；you need 限定需要的书。

items.zh: 谁拿了我的蓝色文件夹？
items.en: Who took my blue folder?
answers: Who took my blue folder?

items.en: This crayon broke in two.
answers: This crayon broke in two.

items.en: One of my gloves is missing.
answers: One of my gloves is missing.
items.notes: one of 后接复数 gloves，主语仍是 one。

items.en: Put the scissors away in the box.
answers: Put the scissors away in the box.
items.notes: scissors 通常用复数；put away：收好。

items.en: I will put out the bowls; you do the spoons.
answers: I will put out the bowls; you do the spoons.
items.notes: put out：摆好；后半句 do 代替重复动作。

items.zh: 袜子已经干了，可以收进来了。
items.en: The socks are dry. We can bring them in.
answers: The socks are dry. We can bring them in.

items.zh: 猫把毛线球滚到了沙发后面。
items.en: The cat rolled a ball of wool behind the sofa.
answers: The cat rolled a ball of wool behind the sofa.
items.notes: a ball of wool：毛线球；behind：在后面。

items.en: The door is open, and cold air is coming in.
answers: The door is open, and cold air is coming in.

items.zh: 这只抽屉只能拉开一半。
items.en: This drawer only opens halfway.
answers: This drawer only opens halfway.

items.zh: 我够不到最上面的架子。
items.en: I cannot reach the top shelf.
answers: I cannot reach the top shelf.
I can't reach the top shelf.

items.zh: 爸爸正在给自行车打气。
items.en: Dad is pumping up the bicycle tyres.
answers: Dad is pumping up the bicycle tyres.

items.en: Keep the wet towel off the bed.
answers: Keep the wet towel off the bed.

items.en: The flowers do not need water today.
answers: The flowers do not need water today.
The flowers don't need water today.
items.notes: need water：需要水；flowers 为复数。

items.en: It is my turn to take out the rubbish.
answers: It is my turn to take out the rubbish.

items.en: I would like a little more soup.
answers: I would like a little more soup.
items.notes: a little more：再来一点，用于不可数名词。

items.zh: 这个苹果里面是红色的。
items.en: This apple is red inside.
answers: This apple is red inside.

items.en: Wait before eating. The porridge is still hot.
answers: Wait before eating. The porridge is still hot.

items.en: We each get half a pear.
answers: We each get half a pear.

items.zh: 桌上没有干净的叉子了。
items.en: There are no clean forks on the table.
answers: There are no clean forks on the table.

items.en: Stack the empty plates, please.
answers: Stack the empty plates, please.

items.en: I spilled juice on my shoes.
answers: I spilled juice on my shoes.

items.en: This bread is too hard to bite.
answers: This bread is too hard to bite.

items.zh: 你想把橘子留到以后吃吗？
items.en: Do you want to save the orange for later?
answers: Do you want to save the orange for later?

items.zh: 饼干藏在罐子的最底下。
items.en: The biscuits are at the bottom of the tin.
answers: The biscuits are at the bottom of the tin.
items.notes: at the bottom of：在……最底部。

items.en: You choose first. I will take the other one.
answers: You choose first. I will take the other one.
items.notes: the other one：两个中剩下的一个。

items.zh: 我们给新同学留点地方吧。
items.en: Let's make room for the new pupil.
answers: Let's make room for the new pupil.

items.zh: 那只是玩笑，但我不喜欢。
items.en: It was a joke, but I did not like it.
answers: It was a joke, but I did not like it.
It was a joke, but I didn't like it.

items.en: I did not push you on purpose.
answers: I did not push you on purpose.
I didn't push you on purpose.

items.zh: 你愿意加入我们的队吗？
items.en: Would you like to join our team?
answers: Would you like to join our team?
items.notes: would you like to：邀请；join：加入。

items.zh: 不用人人都选一样的颜色。
items.en: We do not all have to choose the same colour.
answers: We do not all have to choose the same colour.
We don't all have to choose the same colour.

items.en: She gave me her seat.
answers: She gave me her seat.
items.notes: give someone something：把某物给某人。

items.zh: 我答应给他留一张贴纸。
items.en: I promised to save him a sticker.
answers: I promised to save him a sticker.
items.notes: promise to：答应做；save someone something：给某人留某物。

items.zh: 这幅画是我们一起完成的。
items.en: We made this picture together.
answers: We made this picture together.
items.notes: together：一起；made 是 make 的过去式。

items.en: You can try again after losing.
answers: You can try again after losing.

items.en: Put your coat on after breakfast.
answers: Put your coat on after breakfast.

items.en: We left home later than usual today.
answers: We left home later than usual today.

items.zh: 早读开始前还有十分钟。
items.en: We have ten minutes before morning reading starts.
answers: We have ten minutes before morning reading starts.

items.en: The music lesson is now in the afternoon.
answers: The music lesson is now in the afternoon.
items.notes: in the afternoon：在下午；now 表示当前安排。

items.en: I visit Grandma on Wednesdays.
answers: I visit Grandma on Wednesdays.

items.zh: 作业做完以后，我才打开电视。
items.en: I finish my homework before turning on the television.
answers: I finish my homework before turning on the television.
items.notes: before doing：做某事之前；turn on：打开。

items.en: Who is picking me up tonight?
answers: Who is picking me up tonight?
items.notes: pick someone up：接某人；进行时可表示已安排的事。

items.zh: 钟慢了，我们可能会迟到。
items.en: The clock is slow. We may be late.
answers: The clock is slow. We may be late.
items.notes: may：可能；slow 用于钟表表示走得慢。

items.zh: 睡觉前我喜欢听一个故事。
items.en: I like a story before bed.
answers: I like a story before bed.

items.en: Remember your rain boots tomorrow morning.
answers: Remember your rain boots tomorrow morning.
items.notes: remember 在此提醒不要忘记带某物。
